articles.title: How to use SignPad
articles.subtitle: Your daily warehouse workflow
articles.description: Follow a load from picking and labeling to inspection, loading, signatures, and the printed bill of lading.
articles.introduction: Start with a SignPad that is already paired and configured with MES. The illustrated guide uses training data: always scan your current paperwork and match the load, DC, and PO before confirming work.

sections.title: Use the picking summary
steps: Match the red LOAD number to the load you are working on.
For picking, scan the bottom-left barcode under Prepared By. It opens Confirm Picking for the load.
After labeling every DC, scan the bottom-right barcode under Checked By to open Confirm Inspection.
sections.note: Picking and inspection use the summary. Labeling and loading use the separate DC slip.

sections.title: One DC barcode, used twice
steps: Check the PO, LOAD, and DC printed at the top of the slip against the shipment in front of you.
The first scan of the barcode at the bottom of the DC slip opens labeling. Complete the labels and tap Confirm labeled.
After every DC is inspected and the inspector signs, scan the same barcode again. It now opens Confirm Loading.
sections.note: Keep the same DC slip. There is no separate loading barcode to print or find.

sections.title: Pick the load
steps: Scan the barcode under Prepared By on the picking summary. Check the load number, DC, PO, and box quantity for each shipment.
Select each shipment you have finished picking. Use Check All only when every listed shipment is ready.
Tap Confirm. The number in brackets is the number of selected shipments.
sections.note: A checked blue row is selected, but is saved only after you confirm. Next, scan a DC-slip barcode to label that shipment.

sections.title: Label each shipment
steps: Scan the barcode at the bottom of the DC slip. Match both the DC and PO; two shipments can share a DC number.
Match the DPCI, item description, and box count to the shipment, then finish the physical labeling.
Tap Confirm labeled. Repeat with the next DC slip until every shipment on the load is labeled.
sections.note: This confirms only the shipment on the scanned slip, not every shipment on the load.

sections.title: Inspect the load
steps: After every DC is labeled, scan the barcode under Checked By on the picking summary. Check the load number.
Inspect each shipment, then select its row. Check the box count on the right. Use Check All only after inspecting every shipment.
Tap Confirm. When the last DC is confirmed, the inspector signature page opens automatically.
sections.note: A yellow row with a ban icon means labeling is incomplete. Complete the missing labeling, then tap Reload details.

sections.title: Sign to release the load
steps: After all DCs are inspected, review the load number and PO/DC list on the landscape signature screen.
Draw the inspector's signature in the white area. Tap CLEAR if you need to start again.
Tap SIGN to save the inspector signature and release the load for loading.
sections.note: Next, scan the same DC-slip barcode again to confirm loading.

sections.title: Load each shipment
steps: After inspection and signing, scan the same DC-slip barcode. Verify that Confirm Loading shows the correct load number, DC, and PO.
Match the DPCI, descriptions, and box counts, then complete the physical loading for that shipment.
Tap Confirm Loading. Repeat for the remaining shipments.
sections.note: A count such as (1/2) means one shipment was already loaded out of two when the page opened. It is not the position of the current DC.

sections.title: After loading: scan the summary
steps: Finish and confirm loading for every DC slip, then use the ALL Outbound Loads Summary for the correct date.
Find the matching Load Number and scan the barcode directly beneath that load's load / PRO information.
Complete the shipper signature first, then the driver signature. Both must be saved before printing the BOL.
sections.note: Use the barcode under the correct load on the outbound summary to begin BOL signing.

sections.title: Shipper signs first
steps: On the shipper signature screen, tap SIGN to open the drawing area.
Have the shipper sign in the white area. Tap CLEAR to try again.
Tap CONFIRM. The phone moves to the driver signature.
sections.note: Hand the phone to the driver. Both parties must sign before printing.

sections.title: Driver signs next
steps: On the driver signature screen, tap SIGN to open the drawing area.
Have the driver sign in the white area. Tap CLEAR to try again.
Tap CONFIRM and wait for both signatures to save.
sections.note: When both signatures are saved, the phone offers to print the BOL.

sections.title: Print the signed BOL
steps: Wait until the phone shows Signature saved. Print the BOL?
Tap PRINT to send the signed BOL to the configured printer.
Collect the printed document and check that it is for the correct load.
sections.note: Loading and both signatures are complete. The signed BOL is ready for the shipment.

articles.title: How to use Dispatcher
articles.subtitle: Your MES tasks, on your phone
articles.description: Match familiar MES desktop functions to Dispatcher, then schedule loads, start loading, pair with MES, and print paperwork from your phone.
articles.introduction: Dispatcher brings familiar MES dispatch tasks to your phone. Compare desktop functions with their mobile equivalents, then review loads, schedule pickups and arrivals, start loading, and print through paired MES. Training examples may show different loads; always match your current paperwork.

sections.title: Your MES work, at the dock
steps: MES: Outbound > Load List. Dispatcher: Today / Outbounds. Review pickup times and shipment progress.
MES: Load List > Set Time or pencil. Dispatcher: Outbounds > Assign time / Reschedule. Save the pickup time for the whole load.
MES: Inbound > Shipment Details > ETA Time. Dispatcher: Inbounds > Assign time / Reschedule. Save an incoming shipment's arrival time.
MES: Outbound > Gate > dock assignment. Dispatcher: Today > Start Loading. Choose a dock and confirm trailer / seal.
MES: MES menu > plus above the clock. Dispatcher: Config > scan icon. Pair the phone with a MES desktop.
MES: Load List > printer on the load row. Dispatcher: Outbounds > Print > Picking List. Print the summary and DC breakdowns.
MES: Load List > printer beside a PO. Dispatcher: Outbounds > Print > Shipping Label. Choose the DC / PO and print its labels.
MES: Gate > right-click truck > View BOL. Dispatcher: Outbounds > Print > Bill of Lading. Print the saved full-load BOL.
sections.note: Scheduling and starting loading connect directly to MES. Printing needs a paired desktop that is connected and signed in with the MES Office module enabled; choose the printer in Android.

sections.title: Sign in to Dispatcher
steps: Enter your username: Open Dispatcher and enter your MES username. The app remembers the username for next time.
Enter your password: Use your MES account password. Ask your supervisor if you do not have an account.
Tap Sign in: Wait for the live load pages to open. If offered phone sign-in, enable it with phone security or choose Not now.
sections.note: If you enabled phone sign-in, use Use phone security for the saved account. An expired session may still require your MES password.

sections.title: See the day ahead
steps: In MES: review Outbound Loads: Load List groups the shipments under each load, with pickup times and checklist progress.
In Dispatcher: open Today: Check the date, swipe the timeline or open its vertical view, then scroll through the load cards.
Refresh before coordinating work: Pull down until Release to refresh. Config > Today page can show Inbounds, Outbounds or Both.
sections.note: Times use the factory time zone. Phone cards summarize the same MES work; they do not edit the warehouse checklist.

sections.title: Find the outbound load
steps: In MES: find the load row: Use Load List to check the load number, carrier, DC shipments and current progress.
In Dispatcher: open Outbounds: Use Today, All, Needs time or Complete. Match the load number and carrier on the card.
Open the task you need: Assign time or Reschedule changes its pickup. Print opens its paperwork choices.
sections.note: One card represents a whole load. Progress counts completed DC shipments, not individual cartons.

sections.title: Set the pickup time
steps: In MES: Set Pickup Time: The load's Set Time button or pencil opens the date and time picker shown above.
In Dispatcher: choose date and time: Tap Assign time or Reschedule. Pick a date, then a slot or Choose a custom time.
Save the whole load's pickup: Tap Save appointment and wait for MES. If prompted about another load, choose another time or Keep time.
sections.note: If a save times out, refresh and check before retrying. Offline changes cannot save. Desktop crop shows time controls.

sections.title: Plan inbound arrivals
steps: In MES: open the shipment's ETA: Open Inbound Shipment Details and click ETA Time to reach Set ETA Time.
In Dispatcher: open Inbounds: Match the container or trailer. Tap Assign time or Reschedule and choose the date and time.
Save the expected arrival: Tap Save appointment and wait for confirmation. Refresh the incoming shipment to check it.
sections.note: This schedules arrival; it does not receive the cargo or complete unloading, counting, inspection or putaway.

sections.title: Choose a loading dock
steps: In MES: use Gate Control: The desktop shows dock availability and waiting trucks. Assign a waiting truck to an available dock.
In Dispatcher: tap Start Loading: On Today or the vertical timeline, open the load and select an Available dock.
Check the assignment: Match the load and dock. Docks occupied by another load or under maintenance cannot be selected.
sections.note: This is the phone route for starting loading. It does not expose all desktop yard or gate-management functions.

sections.title: Confirm the trailer
steps: In MES: enter truck details: Truck Register includes trailer and seal fields before the desktop's dock-assignment steps.
In Dispatcher: confirm trailer / seal: After choosing a dock, check the load. Enter the required trailer number and optional seal.
Confirm and wait for MES: Tap Confirm. Loading begins after the assignment succeeds; check any prefilled values first.
sections.note: Dispatcher's Confirm also starts loading. Driver/contact fields and other desktop registration options are not included.

sections.title: Pair the phone with MES
steps: In MES: display the pairing QR: Click the plus button above the clock on the desktop's main menu.
In Dispatcher: scan the desktop: While signed in, open Config, tap the top-right scan icon, and scan the MES QR code.
Check the station connection: Paired MES should show the intended station and Connected. The phone example is still Unpaired.
sections.note: For printing, keep the paired desktop connected and signed in with the MES Office module enabled. Pairing is not needed for scheduling.

sections.title: Print picking paperwork
steps: In MES: use the load-row printer: The highlighted icon prepares the picking summary and shipment breakdowns for the load.
In Dispatcher: choose Picking List: Tap Print on the load, then Picking List. Wait for the paired MES to prepare and send the PDF.
Choose sections and print: Review the summary and eligible DC breakdowns, tap Print selected, then choose the Android printer.
sections.note: Each selected section includes all its pages. Use the summary and DC slips for the SignPad workflow.

sections.title: Print a shipment's labels
steps: In MES: use the shipment printer: Expand the load and use the printer beside the correct PO. This is different from the load-row printer.
In Dispatcher: choose the DC / PO: Open Print > Shipping Label, match both DC and PO, and tap an eligible Ready row.
Check print completion: Complete Android printing and keep the app session active. Successful printing then saves Printed in MES.
sections.note: Printed rows are disabled. A download or preview alone does not mark the labels Printed.

sections.title: Check the bill of lading
steps: In MES: open View BOL: Right-click a dock with its truck assigned, then choose View BOL to open that load's BOL.
In Dispatcher: choose Bill of Lading: Open the load's Print menu and read the signature badge before requesting the saved document.
Print the document you need: Tap Bill of Lading, wait for the PDF, then review and print it through Android.
sections.note: Shipper Signed is not Both Signed. Complete final signatures in SignPad; BOL editing stays in desktop MES.

sections.title: Finish printing in Android
steps: Choose the destination: Tap Select a printer and choose the intended printer. If offered, Save as PDF saves a file; choose a physical printer for paper output.
Review the print settings: Expand the options to check copies, paper size and page range. For shipping labels, use the correct label printer and matching paper.
Print and check the result: Review the preview and load number, then use Android's print action. Wait for completion and collect the correct pages or labels.
sections.note: Ask your administrator to enable the printer's Android print service. Options vary by phone and printer. This screen uses a training PDF and has no printer selected yet.
